_comment: RECOVERY PIPELINE v3 — Phase 3 title templates. NINE structurally different title shapes replacing the single 'INVENTEDWORD + fire emoji + description #N' formula that fingerprinted the channel as a bot. Placeholders: TRACKNAME (uppercased track name), {genre}, {mix_number}, {genre_hashtag}. Includes no-emoji variants, description-first, a question, and duration-front shapes. One template is chosen per upload, not repeating within the last TITLE_HISTORY_WINDOW picks.
templates: Is This the Best {genre} Track of 2026? TRACKNAME | {genre_hashtag}
